title: Astroid Spinodal Boundary in Phase-Based Ising Machines
summary: Oscillator Ising machines (OIMs) and dynamical Ising machines (DIMs) encode binary spins in phase states stabilized by second-harmonic injection (SHI). In a coupled network, the competition between SHI and the instantaneous local network field reshapes each oscillator's conditional energy landscape. We show that this competition drives a transition between monostable and bistable regimes through an astroid spinodal boundary. Near this boundary, the barrier scales as $ΔE_i\proptoμ_i^{3/2}$ at generic smooth points and as $ΔE_i\proptoμ_i^{2}$ at the longitudinal cusp. OIMs and DIMs obey the same spinodal geometry, with their conditional landscapes related by a reversal of the transverse field. Finally, the first-harmonic conditional landscape is mathematically equivalent, up to an additive constant, to the Stoner--Wohlfarth energy of a uniaxial magnetic particle.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了振荡器伊辛机（OIMs）和动态伊辛机（DIMs）中由二次谐波注入稳定的相态，揭示了SHI与局域网络场竞争导致的单稳态-双稳态转变，并发现了与Stoner-Wohlfarth能量模型的数学等价性。
AI.motivation: 理解OIMs和DIMs中二次谐波注入与局域网络场之间的竞争机制，以及这种竞争如何影响系统的条件能量景观和相态转变。
AI.method: 通过理论分析研究SHI与瞬时局域网络场的竞争，定义astroid spinodal边界，分析势垒标度律（ΔE∝μ^(3/2)和ΔE∝μ²），并建立与Stoner-Wohlfarth模型的数学等价关系。
AI.result: 发现了单稳态与双稳态之间的astroid spinodal转变边界；在边界附近观察到两种不同的势垒标度律；OIMs与DIMs具有相同的spinodal几何结构；首次谐波条件景观与Stoner-Wohlfarth能量在数学上等价。
AI.conclusion: OIMs和DIMs中的相态转变受统一的spinodal边界控制，其动力学行为与经典磁学模型存在深刻的数学联系，为理解这类物理伊辛机的运作机制提供了理论基础。

title: Percolating Multifractal Domains at a Polymorphic Phase Boundary
summary: Giant piezoelectricity in ferroelectrics is commonly associated with phase-boundary instabilities, among which the polymorphic phase boundary (PPB) is a prominent example conventionally attributed to the coexistence of ferroelectric phases. Here, using large-scale molecular dynamics simulations of the lead-free (K,Na)NbO3-(Bi,Na)ZrO3 solid solutions, we show that the PPB hosts a percolating multifractal polar domain which governs the dielectric and piezoelectric responses. By quantifying the global fractal dimension and multifractal spectrum width of this polar network, we identify fractal connectivity and multiscale heterogeneity as microstructural order parameters for the PPB. The maximum reversible piezoelectric response occurs when the fractal-domain volume fraction approaches the three-dimensional percolation threshold, suggesting that near-critical polar connectivity enables giant reversible electromechanical coupling. In this mechanism, the fractal backbone preserves polar memory and provides the restoring force required for reversibility, while the surrounding nonfractal regions supply the polar compliance needed for large polarization rotation and strain. These results establish percolating multifractal polar domains as a microscopic mechanism for PPB-enhanced piezoelectricity and suggest fractal connectivity as a design parameter for high-performance piezoelectrics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模分子动力学模拟发现，(K,Na)NbO3-(Bi,Na)ZrO3无铅固溶体中的多晶相边界（PPB）实际上是一种渗流多分形极性畴结构，其分形连通性和多尺度异质性控制着巨压电响应，且最大可逆压电效应出现在分形畴体积分数接近三维渗流阈值时。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为PPB源于铁电相共存，但其微观机理尚不清晰。作者希望通过大规模模拟揭示PPB增强压电性的真正微观机制，为设计高性能无铅压电材料提供新思路。
AI.method: 采用大规模分子动力学模拟，研究(K,Na)NbO3-(Bi,Na)ZrO3固溶体；通过计算全局分形维数和多分形谱宽度来量化极性网络结构；分析分形畴体积分数与压电响应的关系。
AI.result: 发现PPB中存在渗流多分形极性畴结构；最大可逆压电响应发生在分形畴体积分数接近三维渗流阈值时；分形骨架提供极性记忆和恢复力，非分形区域提供极化旋转所需的顺应性。
AI.conclusion: 渗流多分形极性畴是PPB增强压电性的微观机制，分形连通性可作为设计高性能压电材料的关键参数，为无铅压电材料的优化提供了新的理论指导。

title: Inferring Magnetic Material Parameters from Statistical Measures in Strongly Fluctuating Magnetization Dynamics
summary: Magnetic material parameters such as the exchange stiffness and magnetic anisotropy govern the behavior and functionality of magnetic systems, yet their local inference from magnetization data remains challenging, particularly in strongly fluctuating regimes with polycrystalline or multiphase microstructure, where conventional texture-based methods become unreliable. We introduce a magnetization-only framework for inferring material parameters from thermally driven magnetization dynamics. Using micromagnetic simulations, we extract statistical quantities such as temporal mean and latent entropy from the magnetization dynamics, fit models to these descriptors, and invert the models to infer material parameters. We show that this framework enables material-parameter inference as well as grain-boundary detection in a heterogeneous sample. Among the descriptors considered, latent entropy yields more accurate parameter estimates than the temporal mean. Our results establish latent entropy as an efficient descriptor for inferring magnetic material parameters from dynamical magnetization data and point toward its use for experimental parameter extraction at high temperatures and, more broadly, under strongly fluctuating conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种仅基于磁化数据的框架，通过分析热驱动磁化动力学中的统计量（如时间均值和潜熵），来推断磁性材料参数（如交换刚度和磁各向异性），并展示了在异质样品中识别晶界的能力。研究发现潜熵比时间均值更准确。
AI.motivation: 磁性材料参数（如交换刚度和磁各向异性）对系统行为至关重要，但传统基于织构的方法在多晶或多相微结构的强涨落区域中不可靠，亟需一种新的局部推断方法。
AI.method: 利用微磁模拟生成热驱动磁化动力学数据，提取时间均值和潜熵等统计量；对这些描述符拟合模型，再通过模型反演来推断材料参数。
AI.result: 该框架成功实现了材料参数推断，并在异质样品中实现了晶界检测；潜熵相比时间均值提供了更准确的参数估计。
AI.conclusion: 潜熵是一种高效描述符，可用于从动态磁化数据推断磁性材料参数，尤其适用于高温及强涨落条件下的实验参数提取。

title: Anisotropic Spin Polarization and magnetic spin hall effect in Ferromagnets
summary: Spin-dependent transport in ferromagnets underpins the development of high-density spintronic memories. Spin-dependent transport in strong spin-orbit-coupled ferromagnets exhibits a significant anisotropy. Both the overall spin polarization during charge transport and the magnetic spin Hall conductivity are found to exhibit pronounced anisotropy when the magnetization is tilted away from the crystallographic easy axis or when the electric field is rotated relative to the crystal axes. These anisotropic responses originate primarily from spin-orbit coupling, which is identified as the key driver of the large anisotropy observed in ferromagnet. Furthermore, strain tunability of the magnetic spin Hall anisotropy is demonstrated, with tensile strain progressively enhancing the oscillatory amplitude of the spin Hall conductivity. These findings establish strong spin-orbit-coupled ferromagnets as a platform for anisotropic spin-current generation and field-free spintronic devices that exploit intrinsic material anisotropy for improved performance and energy efficiency.

AI.tldr: 研究发现强自旋轨道耦合铁磁体中的自旋输运具有显著各向异性，且可通过应变调控磁性自旋霍尔电导的振荡幅度，为各向异性自旋流产生和无场自旋电子器件提供了新平台。
AI.motivation: 探索强自旋轨道耦合铁磁体中自旋输运的各向异性特性及其物理机制，以实现更高效的自旋电子器件。
AI.method: 通过改变磁化方向（偏离晶轴）和电场方向（相对晶轴旋转），系统研究自旋极化率和磁性自旋霍尔电导的各向异性行为；并施加拉伸应变观察其对自旋霍尔各向异性的调控效果。
AI.result: 发现自旋极化率和磁性自旋霍尔电导均呈现显著各向异性；拉伸应变能逐步增强自旋霍尔电导的振荡幅度。
AI.conclusion: 强自旋轨道耦合铁磁体可作为各向异性自旋流产生和无场自旋电子器件的理想平台，利用其内在各向异性提升器件性能和能效。

title: Gaps in unconventional superconductors
comment: 34 pages, 15 figures, a pedagogical article to review and introduce the topic
summary: The energy gap is one of the defining properties of a superconductor and appears because the quasiparticle excitations radically change once a metallic system enters the superconducting state. Unconventional superconductors typically exhibit a non-uniform gapping and therefore show physical effects that are subject to intense research. In this review, we provide an overview of concepts needed to understand how unconventional superconductors are different from conventional ones, where the gapping comes from and how it expresses itself in experimentally accessible quantities. This should give the basis to understand current open research questions and navigate the recent literature that tend to contain contradictory conclusions.

AI.tldr: 综述了非常规超导体与常规超导体的能隙差异，解释了能隙的起源及其在实验可测量量中的表现，为理解当前研究问题和矛盾文献提供了基础。
AI.motivation: 非常规超导体呈现出非均匀的能隙，导致丰富的物理效应，但相关文献中存在许多相互矛盾的结论，需要系统梳理基本概念。
AI.method: 通过综述方式，对比常规与非常规超导体的能隙特性，阐述能隙的起源及其在实验观测中的表现形式。
AI.result: 提供了理解非常规超导体能隙的基本概念框架，解释了非常规超导体与常规超导体的关键区别。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为研究者理解当前非常规超导体的开放问题和解读相互矛盾的文献提供了必要的基础知识。

title: Dirac Fermion Scattering and Pseudospin Polarization in Structurally Asymmetric Graphene Wormholes
summary: We study the quantum transport of massless Dirac fermions through two asymptotically flat graphene sheets connected by a structurally asymmetric catenoid wormhole in $(2+1)$-dimensional curved spacetime. Analytic scattering basis functions are derived: Hankel functions of integer order (in the half-flux sector) in the flat sheets and Gauss hypergeometric functions in the curved throat. We construct a transfer matrix via piecewise numerical matching, verifying unitarity up to numerical precision. The transmission probability rises monotonically to unity at high energies. Global transmission exhibits mirror degeneracy under inversion of structural asymmetry, but local observables depend on incidence direction. The manifold's spin connection acts as a Hermitian coupling inducing an $A/B$ sublattice imbalance at the throat. Structural asymmetry induces a local pseudospin imbalance. A larger curvature radius enhances $P_z$ polarization via a larger geometric phase; abrupt incidence suppresses it. Sub-barrier modes exhibit a negative transmission phase time, compatible with Hartman-type wave-packet reshaping.

AI.tldr: 本文研究通过结构非对称的虫洞连接两个石墨烯片的量子输运，推导了解析散射基函数，构造了传输矩阵，发现透射概率在高能下单调趋于1，并讨论了自旋连接、赝自旋失衡、几何相位以及负传输相时间等效应。
AI.motivation: 探索在(2+1)维弯曲时空中，通过非对称马鞍面虫洞连接的两个石墨烯片中的狄拉克费米子量子输运行为，特别是结构不对称性对输运性质的影响。
AI.method: 基于解析散射基函数（平坦区域为整数阶汉克尔函数，弯曲喉区为高斯超几何函数），通过分段数值匹配构建传递矩阵，并验证其幺正性。
AI.result: 透射概率在高能下单调趋于1；全局传输在结构不对称反转下呈现镜像简并，但局域可观测量依赖于入射方向；自旋连接诱导A/B子格失衡；结构不对称诱导局域赝自旋失衡；曲率半径增大通过几何相位增强P_z极化，陡峭入射抑制之；亚垒模式呈现负传输相时间。
AI.conclusion: 弯曲虫洞结构对石墨烯中狄拉克费米子的输运具有显著调控作用，结构不对称性、曲率及入射角度均可用于操控量子输运特性。

title: Non-Hermitian Random Matrix Theory of Jamming in Active Disordered Media
summary: We develop a theoretical framework for the mechanics of active jammed systems based on non-Hermitian random matrix theory. Starting from a microscopic model of active particles with non-reciprocal interactions, we formulate the linearized dynamical matrix as a non-Hermitian perturbation of a Wishart ensemble describing the passive contact network. Using Girko's Hermitization together with the self-consistent Born approximation, we derive a self-consistent equation for the low-frequency resolvent based on the full Marchenko--Pastur distribution. We show that active non-reciprocity regularizes the soft-mode divergence at the jamming transition, leading to a scaling law for the mechanical compliance. We further establish a crossover between perturbative and activity-dominated regimes and propose a corresponding scaling form near the active jamming point.

AI.tldr: 本文基于非厄密随机矩阵理论，建立了活性阻塞系统力学的理论框架，推导出活性非互易性如何正则化阻塞转变处的软模发散，并给出力学柔量的标度律。
AI.motivation: 活性阻塞系统中非互易相互作用导致传统力学分析失效，亟需新的理论框架来理解活性物质对阻塞转变的调控机制。
AI.method: 从活性粒子微观模型出发，将线性化动力学矩阵构造为非厄密扰动下的Wishart系综；结合Girko厄密化方法与自洽Born近似，基于完整Marchenko–Pastur分布导出低频resolvent的自洽方程。
AI.result: 活性非互易性正则化了阻塞转变处的软模发散，得到力学柔量的标度律；建立了从微扰区到活性主导区的交叉行为，提出活性阻塞点附近的标度形式。
AI.conclusion: 该框架揭示了活性非互易性对阻塞转变的关键正则化作用，为理解活性无序系统的力学行为提供了统一的非厄密随机矩阵理论工具。

title: Quantum spin-glass criticality in disordered frustrated dimer magnets
summary: We study quantum phase transitions of Mott insulators between spin-glass and featureless paramagnetic phases. Specifically, we consider a triangular-lattice bilayer Heisenberg model with bond disorder. The clean system has two phases, a dimer quantum paramagnet and a non-collinear antiferromagnet, separated by a quantum critical point. Bond disorder destroys the antiferromagnetic phase via the interference of dipolar textures and results in spin-glass order, such that the system features a quantum phase transition between spin-glass and dimer phases. We study the vicinity of this transition using a variant of bond-operator theory and calculate thermodynamic observables as well as excitation spectra. Bond disorder leads to strong inhomogeneities near the transition which suppresses non-collinearities and leads to anomalously weak glassiness in the near-critical quantum spin glass. We characterize the low-energy excitations which have a strong tendency towards spatial localization, and we track the behavior of the amplitude (i.e. Higgs) mode across the glass phase whose spectral weight we find to be strongly suppressed due to interference effects.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了三角格子双层海森堡模型中键无序导致的量子相变，特别是自旋玻璃相与无特征顺磁相之间的转变，发现键无序通过偶极织构干涉破坏反铁磁序，导致近临界量子自旋玻璃出现异常弱的玻璃化行为，并分析了局域化低能激发和振幅（Higgs）模的强烈抑制。
AI.motivation: 理解无序量子磁体中自旋玻璃相与顺磁相之间的量子相变机制，以及键无序如何影响非共线反铁磁体和振幅模的行为。
AI.method: 采用键算子理论的变体，对三角格子双层海森堡模型进行理论分析，计算热力学可观测量和激发谱。
AI.result: 键无序导致反铁磁相被破坏，出现自旋玻璃序；近临界区域非共线性被抑制，玻璃化行为异常弱；低能激发趋于空间局域化；振幅（Higgs）模的谱权重因干涉效应被强烈抑制。
AI.conclusion: 键无序可引来自旋玻璃-顺磁量子相变，且该转变附近展现出非平庸的局域化和干涉效应，对理解无序量子磁体中的临界现象具有重要意义。

title: Isolation of spin-valley locked nodal-line fermions in $d$-wave $\mathrm{AV_2X_2O}$ altermagnets
summary: Crystalline symmetries stabilize topological states with distinct electronic properties, while altermagnets exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization. Here, we combine first-principles calculations with a minimal tight-binding model to realize $C$-paired spin-valley-locked nodal-line fermions in the $d$-wave altermagnet $\mathrm{AV_2X_2O}$ (A = Rb, Cs, or K; X = Te, Se, or S). The low-energy electronic structure hosts coexisting spin-degenerate and spin-polarized nodal lines around $C_{4z}$-paired valleys near the Fermi level. The spin-polarized nodal lines are protected by the out-of-plane mirror symmetry $\mathcal{M}_z$ and remain robust against spin-orbit coupling. The minimal model reveals their microscopic origin and establishes a general design principle for their isolation. Layer engineering and electronic correlations serve as material-specific knobs for realizing these isolated spin-valley-locked nodal lines near the Fermi level. Our results establish the $\mathrm{AV_2X_2O}$ family as a versatile platform for exploring topological spin-valley locking in $d$-wave altermagnets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算和紧束缚模型，在d波交变磁体AV₂X₂O家族中实现了C配对的自旋-谷锁定节线费米子，发现了共存的简并和极化节线，并展示了层工程和电子关联的调控手段。
AI.motivation: 将晶体对称性稳定的拓扑态与交变磁体的自旋劈裂特性相结合，探索d波交变磁体中新型自旋-谷锁定拓扑态的存在性和微观机制。
AI.method: 结合第一性原理计算和最小紧束缚模型，分析AV₂X₂O家族材料的电子结构，并通过层工程和电子关联进行调控。
AI.result: 发现了C₄z配对谷附近共存的spin-degenerate和spin-polarized节线，自旋极化节线由面外镜面对称性ℳ_z保护且对自旋-轨道耦合具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 确立了AV₂X₂O家族作为研究d波交变磁体中拓扑自旋-谷锁定的通用平台。

title: Lewis-labeled graphs: curly arrows and fishhooks as executable electron transfers
comment: 32 pages, 12 figures, 5 tables, including Supporting Information
summary: The curly-arrow formalism is the lingua franca of organic reaction mechanisms, but it is not executable. Molecular graphs used in rule-based modeling encode atomic connectivity while omitting lone pairs, radical electrons, and distinct sigma and pi components. Topological matching therefore cannot determine whether a reactive center holds the electrons a step consumes, while matching on derived formal charge can reject centers that do hold them. We introduce the Lewis-labeled graph (LLG), whose atom labels carry lone-pair and radical populations and whose bond labels separate sigma- and pi-bond occupancies. Bond order, formal charge, and valence electron inventory are derived from these fields. Chemical transformations become resource-constrained double-pushout rules, and curly arrows and coupled fishhooks become locus-sorted electron transfers committed atomically from a common pre-state. For a specified event group, we prove that its execution, application of its induced rule, and the corresponding integral occupancy update are equivalent. Every admissible event conserves valence electrons and net formal charge, and bond-centered fishhook coupling follows from integrality rather than drawing convention. Bidirectional replay recovers all 39,732 mapped reference endpoints, while LLG admits 96 fewer forward and 818 fewer inverse unique outcomes than conventional atom-bond rules. Ten radical records require manual annotation corrections. After review, transition construction succeeds for 101,313 of 101,314 records. The remaining case requires an endpoint atom-map correction rather than an arrow edit. Strict replay accepts all 160 reviewed steps and rejects all 1,120 controlled corruptions. These results establish a common executable state space for molecular graphs, reaction rules, and electron-flow annotations, prior to questions of kinetic or thermodynamic feasibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了刘易斯标记图（LLG），通过区分孤对电子、自由基电子以及σ/π键，将有机化学中的弯箭头机制形式化为可执行的双推图规则，实现了分子图、反应规则和电子流注释的统一可执行状态空间。
AI.motivation: 传统弯箭头是非形式化的描述工具，无法直接执行；基于分子图的规则建模仅记录原子连接性，忽略了孤对电子、自由基电子和σ/π键的区分，导致拓扑匹配无法判断反应中心是否具备反应所需的电子。
AI.method: 提出刘易斯标记图（LLG），在原子标签中携带孤对电子和自由基种群，在键标签中区分σ键和π键占据数，键级、形式电荷和价电子清单均从中推导。化学反应被形式化为资源约束的双推图规则，弯箭头和耦合鱼钩成为从共同前态原子级执行的轨迹排序电子转移。
AI.result: 双向回放恢复了全部39,732个已标注参考端点；LLG相比传统原子-键规则减少了96个正向和818个反向唯一结果。101,314条记录中成功构建了101,313条转换。严格回放接受了所有160个已审核步骤，拒绝了所有1,120个受控损坏。
AI.conclusion: 在考虑动力学或热力学可行性之前，建立了分子图、反应规则和电子流注释的共同可执行状态空间。

title: Formation of $\mathrm{L}1_2$-ordered $γ'$-$\mathrm{Ni}_3\mathrm{Al}$ precipitates in ternary Cu-Ni-Al alloys modelled using an ab initio concentration wave theory and atomistic simulations
summary: Precipitation-strengthened Cu-Ni-Al alloys are of interest for technological applications because coherent, $\mathrm{L}1_2$-ordered $γ'$-$\mathrm{Ni}_3\mathrm{Al}$ precipitates can confer high mechanical strength while allowing the material to retain many of the good transport properties characteristic of elemental Cu. In this work, we study the thermodynamics and phase stability of the pseudobinary $\textrm{Cu}_x (\textrm{Ni}_{3/4} \textrm{Al}_{1/4})_{1-x}$ system, $0 \leq x \leq 1$. We use a computational modelling framework combining first-principles electronic structure calculations with a concentration wave analysis from which atom-atom effective pair interactions are extracted for use in atomistic Monte Carlo simulations. Our modelling reveals three distinct, composition-dependent regimes of phase behaviour, in qualitative agreement with the experimentally determined phase diagram. At low Cu content, Cu is soluble in the $\mathrm{L}1_2$-ordered $\mathrm{Ni}_3\mathrm{Al}$ phase, with a single identifiable phase transition corresponding to chemical ordering between Ni and Al. At intermediate compositions, this high-temperature ordering is followed at lower temperatures by phase separation of Cu and $\mathrm{L}1_2$-ordered $\mathrm{Ni}_3\mathrm{Al}$. Finally, at high Cu content, $\mathrm{L}1_2$-ordered $\mathrm{Ni}_3\mathrm{Al}$ precipitates directly from the solid solution, with no clearly identifiable secondary transition. We relate these phase transformations to features of the underlying electronic structures of the considered alloys. Overall, this work demonstrates a computationally efficient workflow capturing both chemical ordering and coherent precipitation in multicomponent substitutional alloys, with relevance to the study of phenomena such as precipitation strengthening.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过第一性原理计算与蒙特卡罗模拟相结合的方法，系统分析了Cu-Ni-Al伪二元合金的热力学与相稳定性，揭示了三种不同的成分依赖相行为区间，并建立了与电子结构特征的关联，为理解析出强化机制提供了高效计算框架。
AI.motivation: 析出强化的Cu-Ni-Al合金因其兼具高强度与良好输运性能而具有技术应用价值，但对其热力学和相稳定性的系统理解尚不充分，亟需建立能同时描述化学有序化和共格析出的计算模型。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理电子结构计算结合浓度波分析，提取原子间有效对相互作用，进而开展原子蒙特卡罗模拟，研究Cu_x(Ni_{3/4}Al_{1/4})_{1-x}体系的相行为。
AI.result: 发现三种成分依赖的相行为区间：(1)低Cu含量时Cu溶于L1_2有序Ni_3Al相；(2)中等成分时高温有序化后低温发生Cu与L1_2相的相分离；(3)高Cu含量时L1_2有序Ni_3Al直接从固溶体中析出。结果与实验相图定性一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了一种能同时捕捉多组分置换型合金中化学有序化和共格析出的高效计算工作流，对研究析出强化等现象具有重要参考价值。

title: DC Josephson transport in a three-terminal Yu-Shiba-Rusinov system
summary: Scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) of magnetic adatoms on superconducting surfaces has established Yu-Shiba-Rusinov (YSR) states as a versatile platform for studying magnetic-superconducting interactions and phase-coherent quantum transport. Here, we investigate nonreciprocal supercurrent transport in a three-terminal Josephson junction comprising three BCS superconductors (`A', `B' and `C'), each coupled to a magnetic impurity hosting a pair of YSR states. Treating terminals `A' and `C' as primary transport electrodes and terminal `B' as a phase-control node, we demonstrate field-tunable nonreciprocal supercurrent between the primary electrodes. This effect requires both: the control terminal and broken particle-hole symmetry at least in one impurity attached to a primary electrode. Without the control terminal we show that the supercurrent remains reciprocal. Our results establish multi-terminal YSR junctions as a promising platform for engineering nonreciprocal superconducting transport and symmetry-breaking phenomena at the atomic scale.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了三端YSR约瑟夫森结中的非互易超流输运，发现通过控制端和粒子-空穴对称性破缺可实现场可调的非互易超流，为原子尺度超导输运和对称性破缺提供了新平台。
AI.motivation: 探索磁性原子与超导表面形成的YSR态在多端约瑟夫森结中的非互易超流输运特性，揭示其背后物理机制。
AI.method: 构建三端BCS超导-磁杂质YSR态耦合系统，以A、C端为输运电极，B端为相位控制节点，理论分析非互易超流的产生条件。
AI.result: 实现了场可调的非互易超流；该效应需要同时具备控制端B和至少一个主电极所连杂质处的粒子-空穴对称性破缺；无控制端时超流保持互易。
AI.conclusion: 多端YSR结是实现原子尺度非互易超导输运和对称性破缺现象的有前景平台。

title: Near-zero effective magnetization enabling ultra-low threshold currents in spin Hall micro-oscillators
summary: Reducing the electrical current required to excite magnetization dynamics is a central challenge, e.g. for energy-efficient magnonic devices or oscillator-based computing. Spin Hall oscillators typically rely on large current densities to compensate intrinsic magnetic damping, so these systems are usually studied on the nanoscale (Spin Hall Nano Oscillators, SHNOs) to work with moderate currents and a favorable heat dissipation geometry. Here, we demonstrate that engineering a near-zero effective magnetization ($M_\mathrm{eff}$) enables a drastic reduction of the magnetization oscillation threshold current density for Spin Hall oscillators. This makes it possible to excite even comparably large systems with micrometer lateral sizes, so-called "Spin Hall Micro-Oscillators" (SHMOs). Using micro-focused Brillouin light scattering spectroscopy, we quantify the threshold current density in SHMOs based on W/CoFeB/MgO/Ta with near-zero $M_\mathrm{eff}$. We observe threshold current densities as low as $J_{\mathrm{th}}$ = (0.292 $\pm$ 0.025) $\times 10^{10}$ A/m$^{2}$, representing a reduction of more than two orders of magnitude compared with most recent reported SHNOs. Using systematic micromagnetic simulations, we investigate the breaking down of the macrospin approximation and underline the high influence of $M_\mathrm{eff}$ on magnetization dynamics under applied spin currents. Our results establish $M_\mathrm{eff}$ engineering as a powerful strategy for realizing ultra-low-power spin Hall oscillators and energy-efficient magnetization control.

AI.tldr: 本文通过近零有效磁化强度（$M_\mathrm{eff}$）工程，将自旋霍尔振荡器的阈值电流密度降低了两个数量级以上，实现了微米级尺寸的"自旋霍尔微振荡器"（SHMOs），为超低功耗磁化控制提供了新策略。
AI.motivation: 自旋霍尔振荡器（SHNOs）通常需要高电流密度来补偿磁阻尼，且仅限于纳米尺度器件。如何降低阈值电流密度、实现更大尺寸器件的低功耗激发是核心挑战。
AI.method: 通过W/CoFeB/MgO/Ta多层膜结构工程实现近零$M_\mathrm{eff}$，利用微聚焦布里渊光散射光谱学测量阈值电流密度，并结合微磁学模拟研究宏观自旋近似失效及$M_\mathrm{eff}$对自旋电流驱动磁动力学的影响。
AI.result: 实现了阈值电流密度低至$J_{\mathrm{th}} = (0.292 \pm 0.025) \times 10^{10}$ A/m²，比最新报道的SHNOs降低两个数量级以上，且成功在微米级尺寸器件中激发磁化振荡。
AI.conclusion: $M_\mathrm{eff}$工程是实现超低功耗自旋霍尔振荡器及高效磁化控制的有效策略，为能量高效的磁子器件和振荡器计算开辟了新路径。

title: Interface evolution in the two-dimensional quantum Ising model
summary: We consider the unitary time evolution of an interface in the regime of spontaneously broken symmetry of the two-dimensional quantum Ising model. The interface is induced by an initial condition interpolating between the two degenerate ground states in one of the spatial dimensions. The interpolation is left generic in order to investigate the dependence of the late time dynamics on the initial condition. Exploiting the basis of asymptotic quasiparticle states of the bulk theory, the order parameter is analytically determined at large times in the rough phase. The mechanism allowing the breakdown of this phase as the distance from criticality increases emerges from the theory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了二维量子Ising模型中由初始条件诱导的界面在自发对称破缺下的幺正时间演化，利用体理论准粒子态基，解析确定了粗化相中后期序参量，并揭示了远离临界点时该相崩溃的机制。
AI.motivation: 为了理解量子Ising模型中界面动力学的普适性，特别是后期时间演化对初始条件的依赖关系，以及从粗化相到非粗化相的转变机制。
AI.method: 利用体理论中的渐近准粒子态作为基，对序参量进行解析求解；通过设定在两个简并基态之间插值的通用初始条件，分析后期时间行为。
AI.result: 在大时间尺度下，对粗化相中的序参量给出了解析表达式；同时，理论揭示了当系统远离临界点时，粗化相如何失效（即粗化相崩溃）的内在机制。
AI.conclusion: 论文为量子Ising模型中界面演化的非平衡动力学提供了深入理解，尤其阐明了初始条件与后期行为的关联，以及粗化相存在的边界条件。

title: Hidden symmetry at the diabolical points of a biaxial spin
summary: In a rotated frame the biaxial spin Hamiltonian $k_1S_x^2+k_2S_y^2-\mathbf{h}\cdot\mathbf{S}$ is a finite tight-binding chain whose hopping amplitudes are tuned by the applied field. A chain with no vanishing hopping has a nondegenerate spectrum, so a degeneracy can occur only where the field severs the chain. We show that at every point of the exact diabolical-point lattice found by Kececioglu and Garg the chain is severed twice over, in two different rotated frames and at two bonds that are fixed independently. The two severings are carried by projectors that commute with the Hamiltonian but not with each other. In that form they realize the hidden symmetry anticipated by Garg. A single operator built from them pairs the degenerate levels; its rank gives the multiplicity of every lattice point, replacing an earlier continuity and topological argument. Because the two partners of a doublet occupy disjoint stretches of the chain, an exact and manifestly negative determinant fixes the orientation of every cone. At every degeneracy of the model the lower level therefore carries Chern charge -1 in the convention used here.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究双轴自旋哈密顿量在旋转框架下的简并性，发现简并点对应于场将链截断的位置，并通过两个不对易的投影算子揭示了隐藏对称性，给出了每个锥体的取向和Chern荷。
AI.motivation: 理解Kececioglu和Garg发现的精确魔鬼点晶格的结构，揭示其背后的隐藏对称性。
AI.method: 将双轴自旋哈密顿量在旋转框架下映射为有限紧束缚链，通过分析链的截断与投影算子来研究简并性。
AI.result: 在每个魔鬼点处，链在两个不同旋转框架的两个不同键上被截断；两个投影算子实现隐藏对称性；构建的算子配对简并能级，其秩给出多重度；每个锥体方向由显式负行列式固定，较低能级携带Chern荷-1。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在简并点处较低能级始终携带Chern荷-1，用离散链方法替代了之前的连续性与拓扑论证。

title: Where to Find ICEC? - Screening 2442 Systems for Interparticle Coulombic Electron Capture
summary:
Interparticle Coulombic Electron Capture (ICEC) provides an environment-assisted pathway for electron attachment that can compete with photorecombination. Here, we present the first comprehensive survey of ICEC in atom-atom and atom-molecule systems, screening 2442 combinations in search of promising candidates for future experimental investigation.
  We employ the efficient asymptotic approximation to predict ICEC cross sections and electron spectra. Intramolecular nuclear motion is included, while interparticle nuclear dynamics is neglected to permit an extensive survey.
  We identify several classes of atom-atom and atom-molecule systems with favourable ICEC cross sections and ICEC-to-photorecombination ratios, including halogen-halide systems and systems involving a proton and diatomic molecules such as N$_2$, O$_2$, CO, and NO. These findings point to atmospheric and astrochemical environments in which ICEC may be relevant.

AI.tldr: 本文首次大规模筛选了2442种原子-原子和原子-分子组合，寻找具有强ICEC效应的候选体系，发现卤素-卤化物体系及质子与双原子分子（如N₂、O₂、CO、NO）的体系具有较大的ICEC截面，暗示该过程在大气和天体化学环境中可能具有重要意义。
AI.motivation: ICEC为电子附着提供了一条环境辅助的新路径，可与光复合过程竞争，但此前缺乏对其在各类体系中的系统研究，亟需大规模筛选以发现适合实验验证的候选体系。
AI.method: 采用渐近近似高效预测ICEC截面和电子谱；考虑分子内核运动但忽略粒子间核动力学，从而实现对2442种组合的广泛筛选。
AI.result: 发现卤素-卤化物体系以及质子与N₂、O₂、CO、NO等双原子分子的组合具有有利的ICEC截面和ICEC/光复合比，识别出多个有前景的体系类别。
AI.conclusion: ICEC在大气化学和天体化学环境中可能具有实际相关性，为未来实验研究指明了方向。

title: Influence of BaTiO_3 nanoparticles on the anisotropy of the dielectric properties of nematic liquid crystal 5CB
summary: This work is devoted to the mechanisms of dielectric response and electric conductivity of suspensions consisting of the nematic liquid crystal 5CB with different concentrations (from 0 to 10 wt.%) of ferroelectric BaTiO_3 nanoparticles with an average size of 24 nm. We revealed that the incorporation of nanoparticles influences significantly the dielectric permittivity magnitude and anisotropy, as well as dielectric losses of the suspension. A pronounced temperature dependence of the anisotropic dielectric permittivity of the suspensions was found at lower temperatures corresponding to the mesophase state; but it is also present at higher temperatures corresponding to the isophase. The dependence of the mesophase-isophase transition temperature on the concentration of BaTiO_3 nanoparticles appeared nonmonotonic. With increasing temperature, both the capacitance and the electrical resistance of the pure liquid crystal increase, as well as it increases in the suspensions with small concentration of BaTiO_3 nanoparticles. Due to space charge accumulation in the shells of nanoparticles, larger concentrations of BaTiO_3 nanoparticles influence strongly the ionic transport by promoting the formation of ionic-electronic screening. This effect modifies the dielectric properties and conduction mechanisms of the suspension, leading to the nonmonotonic dependence of the mesophase - isophase transition temperature versus the nanoparticle concentration.

AI.tldr: 研究向向列相液晶5CB中添加不同浓度(0-10 wt.%)的BaTiO₃铁电纳米颗粒(24 nm)对其介电响应和电导率的影响。发现纳米颗粒显著影响介电常数、各向异性和介电损耗，且中间相-各向同性相转变温度随浓度呈非单调变化，归因于纳米颗粒壳层空间电荷积累改变离子传输和形成离子-电子屏蔽效应。
AI.motivation: 探索铁电纳米颗粒掺杂对液晶材料介电特性和电导机制的影响规律，特别是理解纳米颗粒浓度如何调制液晶的相变行为和介电响应。
AI.method: 制备不同浓度(0-10 wt.%)BaTiO₃纳米颗粒(24 nm)与向列相液晶5CB的悬浮液，测量其介电常数、介电损耗和电导率随温度的变化，分析纳米颗粒浓度对介电各向异性和相变温度的影响。
AI.result: 1) 纳米颗粒显著改变介电常数大小、各向异性和介电损耗；2) 介电各向异性在低温中间相和高温各向同性相均呈现明显温度依赖性；3) 中间相-各向同性相转变温度随纳米颗粒浓度呈非单调变化；4) 低浓度下纯液晶和悬浮液的电容和电阻随温度升高而增加；5) 高浓度下纳米颗粒壳层空间电荷积累促进离子-电子屏蔽，强烈影响离子传输。
AI.conclusion: BaTiO₃纳米颗粒浓度是调控液晶悬浮液介电特性和相变行为的关键参数，高浓度下空间电荷效应主导的离子-电子屏蔽机制是导致介电性质和相变温度非单调变化的主要原因。

title: Electronically Inactive Intercalated La$_2$NiO$_4$ Layer in Superconducting La$_5$Ni$_3$O$_{11}$
summary: The recent discovery of superconductivity in La$_5$Ni$_3$O$_{11}$ extends the family of superconducting Ruddlesden--Popper nickelates beyond La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. Unlike conventional members of a single Ruddlesden--Popper series, La$_5$Ni$_3$O$_{11}$ contains an intercalated La$_2$NiO$_4$ layer between La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ blocks, raising the question of whether this additional layer participates in the low-energy electronic structure. Here, we combine density functional theory, Wannier-based tight-binding modeling, and rotationally invariant slave-boson calculations to investigate the electronic role of the intercalated layer. We find that realistic electronic parameters place the La$_2$NiO$_4$ layer in gapped insulating regimes rather than a paramagnetic metallic state. Furthermore, realistic interlayer hybridization fails to generate any appreciable La$_2$NiO$_4$-derived spectral weight at the Fermi level. Our results demonstrate that the low-energy electronic structure of La$_5$Ni$_3$O$_{11}$ is governed primarily by the La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ block, with the intercalated La$_2$NiO$_4$ layer remaining electronically inactive. This establishes a minimal low-energy description of La$_5$Ni$_3$O$_{11}$ and provides a unified framework for understanding superconductivity in intercalated Ruddlesden--Popper nickelates.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT、紧束缚模型和旋转不变奴隶玻色子计算，发现La₅Ni₃O₁₁中插入的La₂NiO₄层处于绝缘态而非金属态，低能电子结构主要由La₃Ni₂O₇块主导，插入层电子学上不活跃。
AI.motivation: La₅Ni₃O₁₁作为一种新型Ruddlesden-Popper镍基超导体，其结构中插入了额外的La₂NiO₄层，需要探究该层是否参与低能电子结构，以理解超导机制。
AI.method: 结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、Wannier紧束缚建模和旋转不变奴隶玻色子（RISB）计算，分析插入层在低能下的电子角色。
AI.result: La₂NiO₄层处于能隙绝缘态而非顺磁金属态；层间杂化无法在费米能级处产生显著谱权重；低能电子结构主要由La₃Ni₂O₇块决定。
AI.conclusion: La₅Ni₃O₁₁的低能电子结构主要由La₃Ni₂O₇块主导，插入的La₂NiO₄层电子学上不活跃，这为理解插层Ruddlesden-Popper镍基超导体的超导性提供了统一框架。

title: Giant Bulk-Rashba Splitting in Polar Topological Insulator BiSbTeS$_2$
summary: Bulk-Rashba spin splitting is forbidden in tetradymite topological insulators like Bi$_2$Se$_3$ or Bi$_2$Te$_3$, since their quintuple-layer stacking preserves inversion symmetry. We show that BiSbTeSe$_2$ escapes this restriction: in the Se-Bi-Se-Sb-Te sequence, the structure loses its inversion center, reducing the point group symmetry at $Γ$ from $D_{3d}$ to $C_{3v}$. First-principles density functional calculations with spin-orbit coupling show that this ordered structure retains bulk band inversion and a linearly dispersive surface state of a strong topological insulator. Additionally, its bulk bands acquire a pronounced linear-in-$k$ spin splitting away from $Γ$. Fitting the conduction- and valence-band doublets to symmetry-constrained two-band $k\cdot p$ Hamiltonians, we extract intrinsic linear Rashba coefficients of $α_{\mathrm{CB}}\approx2.66~\mathrm{eV\,\textÅ}$ and $α_{\mathrm{VB}}\approx0.35~\mathrm{eV\,\textÅ}$. The conduction-band value places ordered BiSbTeSe$_2$ among the strongest bulk-Rashba topological-insulator systems reported to date and approaches the coupling found in the benchmark polar Rashba semiconductor BiTeI.Sublattice ordering thus provides a route to giant bulk spin--momentum locking that coexists with protected topological surface states, offering a platform in which bulk Rashba and topological surface contributions to spin and charge transport can be investigated within the same material.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，发现有序结构的BiSbTeSe₂因失去反演对称性而允许体Rashba自旋劈裂，其导带Rashba系数高达2.66 eV·Å，可与基准极性Rashba半导体BiTeI媲美，且同时保留了拓扑绝缘体的表面态，为研究体Rashba与拓扑表面态共存提供了平台。
AI.motivation: 传统四层拓扑绝缘体（如Bi₂Se₃/Bi₂Te₃）因五层堆垛保持反演对称性而禁止体Rashba自旋劈裂。本文旨在寻找一种打破该限制的材料体系，实现体Rashba效应与拓扑表面态共存。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，考虑自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）；通过对称性约束的k·p两带哈密顿量拟合导带和价带双线结构，提取线性Rashba系数。
AI.result: BiSbTeSe₂的Se-Bi-Se-Sb-Te序列破坏了反演对称性，点群从D₃d降至C₃v；保留了体带反转和线性色散表面态（强拓扑绝缘体特征）；体带出现显著的线性k依赖自旋劈裂；导带Rashba系数α_CB≈2.66 eV·Å，价带α_VB≈0.35 eV·Å，前者接近BiTeI水平。
AI.conclusion: 亚晶格有序化为实现巨大的体自旋-动量锁定提供了新路径，该锁定与受保护的拓扑表面态共存，使BiSbTeSe₂成为在同一材料中研究体Rashba效应与拓扑表面态对自旋/电荷输运贡献的理想平台。

title: Quantum Brownian transport in a correlated Gaussian force
summary: We study a classical system-bath model in which a system particle is linearly coupled to a bath of harmonic oscillators. In a system subject to white and correlated Gaussian noises, we derive an expression for the joint probability density, and the mean squared values of the system-bath particles are calculated. For white noise, the mean squared values of the system-bath particles exhibit an anomalous time dependence, which is different from that of normal diffusion. In particular, for a correlated Gaussian noise, the mean squared displacement and mean squared velocity of the bath particle show superspreading growths of $t^5$ and $t^3$ in $t{\ll}τ$, respectively. When $τ=0$, the mean squared velocity of a quantum particle under random noise is proportional to $t$, while the mean squared velocity of a bath particle in the presence of correlated Gaussian noise increases in proportion to $t^2$. This anomalous transport phenomenon results from the mixed derivative structure of the master equation, which couples with the transport coordinates in the diffusion dynamics of the relative coordinates. This result shows that the removal of dissipation in the Caldeira-Leggett framework leads to fundamentally different transport mechanisms characterized by non-diffusive quantum diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一类经典系统-浴模型，分析了系统粒子在噪声影响下的扩散行为，发现白噪声和关联高斯噪声会导致异常时间依赖的均方位移，其中关联高斯噪声下浴粒子的均方位移和均方速度呈现t^5和t^3的超扩散增长，揭示了一种非耗散性的量子扩散机制。
AI.motivation: 探究在经典系统-浴模型中，白噪声和关联高斯噪声对系统-浴粒子扩散行为的影响，特别是揭示去除Caldeira-Leggett框架中耗散项后导致的非耗散性量子扩散现象。
AI.method: 通过系统粒子线性耦合到谐振子浴的模型，推导白噪声和关联高斯噪声下的联合概率密度表达式，计算系统-浴粒子的均方位移和均方速度。
AI.result: 白噪声下系统-浴粒子的均方位移呈现异常时间依赖；关联高斯噪声下，浴粒子在t≪τ时均方位移呈t^5增长，均方速度呈t^3增长；τ=0时，量子粒子均方速度正比于t，而浴粒子均方速度正比于t^2。
AI.conclusion: 混合导数结构的主方程耦合了相对坐标扩散动力学中的输运坐标，导致异常的输运机制，证明了去除Caldeira-Leggett框架中的耗散会引发根本不同的非扩散性量子扩散现象。

title: Quantum Geometry-Driven RKKY: From Flat to Dispersive Bands
summary: In flat-band systems, quantum metric bounds physical observables like superfluid weight and coherence length, suggesting a single geometric scale for spatial correlations. Here, we show that the RKKY exchange in an isolated filled flat band can violate this expectation. With the intraband channel absent, the exchange proceeds via virtual interband transitions across the gap; the kernel becomes the inverse-gap-weighted trace product of the real-space flat-band projector and empty-band projectors. Because the corresponding momentum-space projectors are analytic, the kernel decays exponentially, with a decay length $ξ_\text{RKKY}$ set by the closest singularities of the analytically continued projectors in the complex momentum plane. Thus, this length depends on both the flat-band geometry and the band gap. Applying this formalism to Chern flat-band systems, we find that for small gaps, $ξ_\text{RKKY}$ depends non-monotonically on the quantum metric length: it first decreases, then increases, revealing that stronger quantum geometry can shorten the magnetic exchange range. Upon restoring dispersion, a nontrivial inversion representation can force the overlap between Bloch states at antipodal Fermi points to vanish under gate tuning, producing a $1/R^3$ RKKY tail instead of the conventional $1/R^2$---a geometric selection effect.

AI.tldr: 本文发现平带系统中RKKY交换相互作用的衰减长度不仅依赖于量子度量，还依赖于带隙，且在小带隙下量子度量长度对交换范围呈现非单调调控，同时通过几何选择效应可使RKKY长程尾从1/R²变为1/R³。
AI.motivation: 挑战平带系统中“量子度量唯一决定空间关联尺度”的预期，揭示RKKY交换在孤立填充平带中可违背这一规律。
AI.method: 通过分析平带中仅剩的虚带间跃迁机制，推导RKKY核为投影算符的逆带隙加权迹乘积，利用动量空间投影算符的解析性导出指数衰减长度；对Chern平带系统进行分析，并引入色散恢复下的反转表示。
AI.result: RKKY衰减长度由平带几何与带隙共同决定；小带隙下量子度量长度对ξ_RKKY呈非单调影响（先减后增）；色散恢复后可通过门调控使费米面对映点重叠消失，产生1/R³的RKKY尾。
AI.conclusion: 平带系统的量子度量并非空间关联尺度的唯一决定因素，带隙和几何效应共同调控磁交换范围，且存在几何选择效应可改变RKKY的幂律衰减行为。

title: A novel class of $σ$/$π$-separating orbital localization functionals
summary: Orbital localization methods have a long history in quantum chemistry, as they provide a convenient way to describe individual chemical bonds and local properties. However, only a handful of localization functionals are known up to date, and most localization methods do not separate $σ$- and $π$-orbitals, which is important to describe chemical bonding patterns and reactivity. In this work, we present a new class of localization functionals, based on nucleus-electron physical observables, that preserve $σ$- and $π$-orbitals separation in molecular systems. We also present a general mechanism behind $σ/π$-separating variational localization which can be used for constructing a broader class of $σ/π$-separating localization functionals from other local physical quantities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一类基于核-电子物理可观测量的新型局域化泛函，能够保持分子体系中σ轨道和π轨道的分离，并揭示了σ/π分离变分局域化的一般机制。
AI.motivation: 现有的轨道局域化方法数量有限，且大多数方法无法区分σ轨道和π轨道，而σ/π轨道的分离对于描述化学键模式和反应活性至关重要。
AI.method: 提出基于核-电子物理可观测量的一类新局域化泛函，并构建了σ/π分离变分局域化的一般机制，该机制可推广至其他局域物理量。
AI.result: 新泛函能够有效保持分子体系中σ轨道和π轨道的分离。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为构建更广泛的σ/π分离局域化泛函提供了理论基础和通用机制。

title: Dynamic phase-field model for brittle fracture in grounded glaciers
summary: Fracture and calving of glaciers are key contributors to ice-mass loss and sea-level rise, yet predictive modeling remains challenging. Fracture in grounded glaciers is driven by gravitational forces and is typically studied within the framework of quasi-static linear elastic fracture mechanics. In this work, we show that purely quasistatic brittle fracture simulations within the phase field fracture framework under fixed self-weight can become strongly overdriven after crevasse initiation, producing unphysical thickening of the diffusive crack band and diffuse damage patterns. This pathology arises because gravity drives a growing region ahead of the crack tip beyond the strength surface. To resolve this, we show that the post-nucleation propagation is fundamentally a dynamic instability rather than a quasistatic process and propose the use of dynamic formulations of fracture. We demonstrate that accounting for inertia results in sharp, localized cracks that propagate through the ice thickness. As a second objective, this paper introduces a new dynamic formulation of the phase-field fracture model of Kumar et al. (J. Mech. Phys. Solids 2018) in which elastic, inertial, and gravitational contributions are degraded consistently in fractured regions.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了在固定自重条件下准静态脆性断裂模拟中出现的裂纹带非物理增厚和弥散损伤问题，提出后成核传播本质上是动态失稳而非准静态过程，并引入动态相场断裂模型来产生尖锐、局部的冰裂隙；同时提出了一种新的动态相场断裂公式，一致地退化断裂区域的弹性、惯性和重力贡献。
AI.motivation: 冰川断裂和崩解是冰量损失和海平面上升的关键因素，但目前预测建模仍面临挑战。准静态线弹性断裂力学在裂缝成核后会出现过度驱动、裂纹带增厚和弥散损伤的病态现象，因此需要新的理论框架来准确模拟冰川裂缝的传播。
AI.method: 论文通过相场断裂框架模拟固定自重下的准静态脆性断裂，发现其病态行为；随后提出将后成核传播视为动态失稳过程，引入惯性效应，并提出了Kumar等人(2018)模型的动态相场断裂新公式，其中弹性、惯性和重力贡献在断裂区域被一致地退化。
AI.result: 准静态模拟在裂缝成核后出现裂纹带宽化、弥散损伤等非物理现象；考虑惯性后，动态相场模型产生了尖锐、局部的裂纹，并能沿冰厚方向传播。
AI.conclusion: 冰川裂缝的后成核传播是动态失稳过程，动态相场断裂模型是准确模拟冰川断裂的有效方法；新动态公式保证了断裂区域弹性、惯性和重力贡献的一致退化。

title: Density-wave phases, anisotropic transport, and Planckian dissipation in single crystals of the superconductor La3Ni2O7
comment: 44 pages, 4 figures, 9 extended data, 5 supplementary data, 4 supplementary tables
summary: Pressure-induced superconductivity in bilayer nickelates provides a platform for investigating intertwined roles of charge/spin orders and electric transport in unconventional superconductivity. However, important quantitative information on the transport, such as the absolute value of the resistivity, the anisotropy, and the scattering rate of carriers, remains insufficient due to the lack of accurate measurements using large single crystals. Here we establish a high-precision pressure-temperature phase diagram of high-quality La3Ni2O7 single crystals, by measuring the in-plane and out-of-plane resistivities. We resolve two distinct anomalies associated with density-wave formation with contrasting pressure dependences. The pressure-induced structural transition enhances not only the resistivity values for both directions, but also its anisotropy at low temperatures, demonstrating a pronounced effect of density-wave order on the charge dynamics. Superconductivity with zero-resistance emerges near the boundary where the density-wave phases are fully suppressed, and above Tc, the resistivity exhibits a temperature-linear dependence over a wide temperature range while the scattering rate falls within a regime of the Planckian limit. Our results show that pressure dramatically changes the anisotropic charge transport via modifying density-wave orders, and eventually produces a pronounced strange-metal state with strong scatterings, from which superconductivity develops. This establishes robust density-wave correlations and Planckian dissipation as remarkable features of La3Ni2O7.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高质量La3Ni2O7单晶的面内和面外电阻测量，建立了高压下的精确相图，揭示了密度波序与超导的关联，并发现了普朗克极限附近的奇异金属行为。
AI.motivation: 双层镍酸盐中的压力诱导超导为研究电荷/自旋序与电输运在非常规超导中的交织作用提供了平台，但缺乏大单晶的精确测量，使得电阻率绝对值、各向异性和载流子散射率等重要定量信息不足。
AI.method: 使用高质量La3Ni2O7单晶，分别在面内和面外方向测量高压下的电阻率，建立高精度压力-温度相图。
AI.result: 1) 识别出两个与密度波形成相关的异常，且压力依赖关系相反；2) 压力诱导的结构转变同时增强了两个方向的电阻率及其各向异性；3) 零电阻超导在密度波相被完全抑制的边界附近出现；4) 超导转变温度以上，电阻率在宽温区内呈线性温度依赖，散射率落在普朗克极限范围内。
AI.conclusion: 压力通过修饰密度波序显著改变各向异性电荷输运，最终产生具有强散射的奇异金属态，从中发展出超导。这确立了密度波关联和普朗克耗散是La3Ni2O7的显著特征。

title: On the static dielectric constant of thin dielectrics in extremely scaled silicon nanosheet transistors
summary: We argue that the static dielectric constant of small (thin and/or narrow) semiconductor and insulator nanostructures depends strongly on the their environment. We do so by considering the electronic response simply reviewing, briefly but critically, the existing literature. Regarding the ionic response, in addition to reviewing the literature, we use a simple model to account for the confinement of optical phonons in thin films and show that the reduction of their density of states has a negligible effect on the dielectric constant, in contrast to some claims found in the literature. In general, we argue that in realistic structures, such as double-gated Si nanosheets, the use of the bulk dielectric constants for both the channel and the gate insulators, is justified.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献综述和简单模型分析，论证了小尺寸半导体和绝缘体纳米结构的静态介电常数主要依赖于环境而非本征尺寸效应，并指出在双栅Si纳米片等实际器件中使用体材料介电常数是合理的。
AI.motivation: 针对现有文献中声称纳米结构介电常数会因尺寸减小（如光学声子限制导致态密度降低）而发生显著变化这一争议，作者希望澄清在真实纳米结构中体介电常数是否仍然适用。
AI.method: 采用文献综述方法批判性回顾已有研究，并构建简单模型分析薄膜中光学声子限制效应对介电常数的影响。
AI.result: 发现光学声子态密度降低对介电常数的影响可忽略不计，环境因素（而非尺寸限制）才是决定纳米结构介电常数的关键。
AI.conclusion: 在双栅Si纳米片等实际器件中，使用体材料介电常数是合理的，与某些文献观点相反。

title: The Role of Odd Diffusivity in Multipoint Statistics of State-Dependent Observables
summary: Odd diffusivity is a transverse transport coefficient that appears when time-reversal and parity symmetries are broken. Its most distinctive signature is a probability flux perpendicular to a density gradient, generated by the antisymmetric part of the diffusion tensor. Here we show that for an arbitrary number of state-dependent observables measured at arbitrary times, their joint statistics are independent of the antisymmetric part of the diffusion tensor. Thus, the Lorentz flux does not contribute to any multipoint state-observable measurements. The result clarifies the separate roles of two effects that are often linked together by fluctuation--dissipation relations, i.e., odd mobility and odd diffusivity. This observation demonstrates that the anomalous correlations in odd-diffusive systems originate solely from odd mobility. It also allows the statistics of state-dependent observables in odd-diffusive systems to be computed using conventional Langevin dynamics without the antisymmetric diffusion part while preserving the antisymmetric mobility tensor. It implies that universal relations associated with state-dependent observables alone, such as nonlinear fluctuation--dissipation relations and generalized Green--Kubo relations, remain valid in odd-diffusive systems without modification. We verify our findings through mean back relaxation, the diffusion coefficient, the nonlinear fluctuation--dissipation relation, and a generalized Green--Kubo relation in diverse systems.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，对于任意数量的状态依赖观测量的多点联合统计，完全不受扩散张量反对称部分（奇数扩散率）的影响，即洛伦兹通量不贡献于任何多点测量。奇数扩散系统中的反常关联仅源于奇数迁移率，而奇数扩散率可被安全忽略。
AI.motivation: 厘清时间反演和宇称破缺系统中奇数迁移率与奇数扩散率各自的作用，探究反对称扩散张量（产生垂直于密度梯度的概率流）是否影响状态依赖观测量的统计特性。
AI.method: 理论推导证明任意多点状态观测量联合分布与扩散张量反对称部分无关；通过平均背弛豫、扩散系数、非线性涨落-耗散关系和广义格林-久保关系等多种系统验证。
AI.result: 扩散张量的反对称部分（奇数扩散率）不影响任何状态依赖观测量的联合统计；奇数扩散系统中的异常关联仅来自奇数迁移率；可用不含反对称扩散部分但保留反对称迁移率的常规朗之万动力学等效计算。
AI.conclusion: 与状态依赖观测量相关的普适关系（如非线性涨落-耗散关系、广义格林-久保关系）在奇数扩散系统中无需修改仍然成立。

title: Algebraic Diagrammatic Construction of the Multichannel Dyson Equation
summary: The multichannel Dyson equation (MCDE) was recently introduced as a new approximation scheme to compute the one-body Green function in many-body systems, as reported by Riva et al. in Physical Review Letters, volume 131, article 216401, published in 2023. The physical content of this novel approximation scheme is further clarified by recovering it from an extended version of the algebraic diagrammatic construction (ADC) truncation scheme. It is thus demonstrated that the MCDE approximation lies in between the so-called ADC(2) and ADC(3) truncations of the dynamical self energy. Building on this clarification, the MCDE approximation is tested on the periodic one-dimensional Hubbard model with 4, 6, and 8 site lattices and shown to deliver an improved treatment over ADC(2) of both the quasiparticle peaks and the so-called satellites in the spectral strength distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文澄清了多通道戴森方程（MCDE）近似方案与代数图构造（ADC）截断方案之间的联系，证明MCDE介于ADC(2)和ADC(3)之间，并在一维Hubbard模型上展示了其优于ADC(2)的谱性能。
AI.motivation: 进一步阐明MCDE近似方案的物理内涵，通过将其与ADC截断方案建立联系，明确其在理论框架中的位置。
AI.method: 从扩展版本的ADC截断方案出发，推导MCDE近似；随后在一维Hubbard模型（4、6、8格点）上进行数值测试。
AI.result: MCDE近似在准粒子峰和卫星峰的光谱强度分布上均优于ADC(2)的处理结果。
AI.conclusion: MCDE是一种介于ADC(2)和ADC(3)之间的有效近似，能更准确地描述强关联体系的谱学性质。

title: Preparing Small Gaussian Basis for Highly Accurate Ab Initio Description of Lithium Rydberg States
summary: A new small and highly accurate Gaussian basis set has been developed for the ab initio description of $^2$Li Rydberg excited states up to $n = 7$ and S, P, D, F, and G angular momentum symmetry, and the appropriate optimization protocol is presented. The obtained Rydberg excitation energies are compared with results from other highly accurate approaches. At the EOM-CCSD level of theory the new basis exhibits higher than $10^{-2}$ eV accuracy of the excitation energies and the ionization potential and provides superior results than an analogous universal Gaussian basis set, while utilizing even smaller number of basis functions. Plots of the 1-dimensional Rydberg-orbital cuts reveal a regular nodal structure along the logarithmic scale of the atomic radius reaching tens of angstrom far from the nucleus. The presented Rydberg basis set generation methodology is an important step towards routine ab initio Rydberg-state related investigations of more complex systems, such as large atoms and polyatomic molecules.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一种用于$^2$Li里德堡激发态（最高至n=7，涵盖S、P、D、F、G对称性）的高精度小型高斯基组，并展示了优化方案。在EOM-CCSD水平下，该基组的激发能和电离势精度优于$10^{-2}$ eV，且比通用型里德堡基组使用更少基函数却结果更优。该方法为复杂体系（如大原子和多原子分子）的里德堡态常规研究迈出了重要一步。
AI.motivation: 现有通用里德堡基组在描述高角动量里德堡态时精度有限且基函数冗余，亟需一种既紧凑又高精度的定制化基组，以便将里德堡态研究扩展到更复杂的多原子体系。
AI.method: 开发了针对$^2$Li原子$n\leq7$且含S/G对称性的小型高斯基组，制定了专门的优化协议；在EOM-CCSD水平下计算里德堡激发能和电离势；通过一维里德堡轨道截面图分析节点结构在对数尺度下的径向分布。
AI.result: 新基组在EOM-CCSD下对激发能和电离势的精度高于$10^{-2}$ eV；相比通用基组，用更少基函数获得更优结果；里德堡轨道在对数径向尺度上呈现规则节点结构，延伸至数十埃。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的里德堡基组生成方法为复杂体系（如大原子、多原子分子）的高精度里德堡态从头计算研究提供了实用且可推广的方案。

title: Thermodynamics-Informed Machine Learning for Energy Materials Discovery
summary: Machine learning (ML) is transforming materials discovery by enabling rapid prediction of properties that previously required computationally expensive first-principles calculations. Yet most current ML models remain fundamentally limited to zero-temperature descriptions, learning static lattice energies while neglecting the thermodynamic effects that govern materials behaviour at finite temperature. Because phase stability, functional response, and performance are governed by free-energy landscapes rather than static energies alone, this limitation represents a major barrier to predictive materials design under realistic operating conditions. In this Perspective, we argue that developing thermodynamics-informed ML constitutes one of the most important and least explored frontiers in materials discovery. We examine the fundamental shortcomings of energy-based models, highlighting the essential roles of entropy and anharmonicity in determining free energies and materials functionality. We review emerging strategies, including machine-learned interatomic potentials and hybrid ML-statistical mechanics frameworks, while identifying key challenges related to data availability, transferability, and thermodynamic consistency. Building on these advances, we outline a roadmap for thermodynamics-informed ML centred on direct free-energy learning, entropy-aware representations, and adaptive sampling across temperature. We highlight the transformative opportunities this paradigm offers for energy materials and argue that the next generation of ML models must move beyond static energy predictions towards a thermodynamic description of materials behaviour under realistic operating conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前机器学习材料发现模型局限于零温静态能量预测，忽视了热力学效应。作者主张发展热力学驱动的机器学习，通过直接学习自由能、熵感知表示和温度自适应采样，实现材料在真实工况下的行为预测。
AI.motivation: 现有ML模型仅学习静态晶格能量，无法捕捉温度效应（熵、非谐性）对材料相稳定性、功能响应和性能的决定性影响，这严重阻碍了材料在真实操作条件下的预测性设计。
AI.method: 综述了机器学习原子间势能、混合ML-统计力学框架等新兴策略，提出了热力学驱动ML的路线图：直接自由能学习、熵感知表示、跨温度自适应采样。
AI.result: 论证了热力学驱动ML是材料发现中最重要但探索最少的前沿方向；指出了数据可用性、可迁移性和热力学一致性等关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: 下一代ML模型必须超越静态能量预测，转向对真实工况下材料行为的热力学描述，这对于能源材料领域具有变革性意义。

title: Dual Enhancement of Superconductivity in FeSe/SrTiO3 via Orbital and Correlation Synergy
summary: In iron-based superconductors, the dz2 orbital band typically resides far below the Fermi level and has not been considered to participate in Cooper pairing. Here, using monolayer FeSe/SrTiO3 as a model system, we demonstrate that tip-induced tensile strain controllably shifts the dz2 band toward the Fermi level, driving a two-stage enhancement of superconductivity. In-plane lattice expansion first enhances electronic correlation, amplifying superconductivity in the initial stage. As strain further increases, the upward-shifted dz2 band hybridizes with the dxy band, reconstructing the pairing-active d-orbital bands and inducing a secondary, stronger gap enhancement. Collectively, these two stages enlarge the superconducting gap from 17.8 to 23.6 meV. Throughout this process, invariant Fermi wave vectors confirm that the enhancement originates from band renormalization and reconstruction rather than carrier doping. Our work establishes a route to tailor superconducting states via strain-activated electronic correlations and band engineering, and reveals a previously unrecognized orbital-selective pairing mechanism with broad implications for correlated multiband superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文以单层FeSe/SrTiO3为模型系统，发现针尖诱导拉伸应变可将dz2轨道带移向费米能级，通过两阶段增强超导电性：首先增强电子关联，其次dz2与dxy杂化重构配对轨道带，使超导能隙从17.8增大到23.6 meV。
AI.motivation: 在铁基超导体中，dz2轨道带通常远离费米能级，被认为不参与库珀配对。作者希望探索通过应变激活dz2轨道是否可调控超导电性，并揭示其背后的轨道选择性配对机制。
AI.method: 以单层FeSe/SrTiO3为模型系统，利用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）针尖施加可控拉伸应变，结合扫描隧道谱（STS）测量超导能隙，并通过分析能带演化与费米波矢不变性验证机制。
AI.result: 拉伸应变使dz2带移向费米能级，先增强电子关联（第一阶），后与dxy杂化重构配对活性d轨道带（第二阶），超导能隙从17.8 meV增至23.6 meV。过程中费米波矢不变，排除载流子掺杂效应。
AI.conclusion: 建立了通过应变激活电子关联和能带工程来调控超导态的路线，揭示了此前未被认识的轨道选择性配对机制，对关联多带超导体具有广泛意义。

title: Spin-Orbit Torque's Hidden Partner
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to Physical Review Letters
summary: The spin-orbit torque (SOT) is widely recognized as the primary mechanism for current-driven magnetization switching in nonmagnetic/ferromagnetic bilayers. In this work, we show that, in the presence of interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (iDMI), the Zhang-Li torque, a current-induced spin-transfer torque (STT) acting on nonuniform magnetization at the device boundary, can trigger switching behaviors strikingly similar to those of SOT, including field-assisted deterministic reversal and switching polarity control. These results suggest that the Zhang-Li torque may act as a significant complementary mechanism to SOT. This work provides a broader perspective on the switching physics in heavy metal/ferromagnet (HM/FM) structures and offers practical guidance for the design of SOT-MRAM devices.

AI.tldr: 本文发现在存在界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（iDMI）的情况下，Zhang-Li转矩（一种电流驱动的自旋转移转矩）可以在非磁/铁磁双层结构中引发与自旋轨道转矩（SOT）极为相似的磁化翻转行为，包括场辅助确定性翻转和极性控制，表明Zhang-Li转矩可能是SOT的重要补充机制。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍认为SOT是电流驱动磁化翻转的主要机制，但本文发现Zhang-Li转矩也能产生类似SOT的翻转行为，因此需要重新审视HM/FM结构中的翻转物理机制。
AI.method: 通过理论分析，研究在iDMI存在下，器件边界处非均匀磁化上Zhang-Li转矩（一种STT）对磁化翻转的作用，并与SOT的翻转行为进行对比。
AI.result: Zhang-Li转矩在iDMI存在下能够实现场辅助确定性翻转和翻转极性控制，这些行为与SOT驱动的翻转高度相似。
AI.conclusion: Zhang-Li转矩可作为SOT的重要补充机制，为理解HM/FM结构中的翻转物理提供了更广阔的视角，并为SOT-MRAM器件设计提供了实践指导。

title: Boundary-Driven Anisotropic Coarsening in Conserved Phase Separation
summary: Universal scaling in phase separation is typically assumed to be isotropic in systems with conserved dynamics. Here we show that boundary forcing alone can break this dynamical scaling symmetry, leading to anisotropic coarsening, with different effective global growth laws observed parallel and perpendicular to the boundary. We consider a ternary mixture with two conserved components and a passive species undergoing surface evaporation, which provides a simple setting to investigate this effect. In this case, evaporation leads to a progressive mass loss and to the formation of macroscopic concentration gradients, which, in turn, drive anisotropic coarsening, with different effective growth laws observed parallel and perpendicular to the boundary. At the same time, bulk regions appear to retain the standard Model B scaling, suggesting that the observed anisotropy is mainly induced by boundary fluxes rather than by changes in the intrinsic dynamics. Our results indicate that boundary conditions can play an important role in breaking scaling symmetry and may offer a way to influence coarsening behavior in nonequilibrium phase separation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了边界驱动如何打破相分离中的各向同性标度对称性，导致平行和垂直于边界方向出现不同的粗化生长规律。通过三元混合物（含两种守恒组分和一种蒸发被动组分）的模型，发现表面蒸发导致质量损失和浓度梯度，进而引发各向异性粗化，但体相区域仍保留标准Model B标度，表明各向异性主要由边界通量而非内在动力学改变引起。
AI.motivation: 传统认为具有守恒动力学的相分离体系中的标度行为是各向同性的，本文旨在探究边界条件能否打破这一对称性，并理解其机制。
AI.method: 研究了三元混合物体系，包含两种守恒组分和一种经历表面蒸发的被动组分，通过理论分析和数值模拟考察边界蒸发诱导的质量损失和宏观浓度梯度对粗化动力学的影响。
AI.result: 发现平行和垂直于边界方向展现出不同的有效生长指数（各向异性粗化），而体相区域仍保持标准Model B的各向同性标度行为，表明各向异性主要源于边界通量效应。
AI.conclusion: 边界条件在打破标度对称性中起重要作用，可能为调控非平衡相分离中的粗化行为提供新途径。

title: Disentangling bulk and surface states in the electronic structure of PtBi$_2$(0001)
summary: Recent reports of surface-localized topological superconductivity in trigonal PtBi$_2$ highlight the importance of understanding its surface electronic structure. We investigate the bulk and surface band structure of PtBi$_2$ using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and first-principles calculations. Through photon-energy- and polarization-dependent measurements, we disentangle bulk dispersions from surface states on the two distinct surface terminations of PtBi$_2$(0001). For both terminations, we assign several different surface states and find good agreement between experiment and calculations. Based on our calculations, we analyze the orbital composition in the surface and bulk bands and compare the results to polarization-dependent ARPES measurements. Together, our results provide a coherent picture of the surface electronic structure of PtBi$_2$ across both surface terminations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过ARPES实验和第一性原理计算，系统解析了三角晶系PtBi₂(0001)两个不同表面终止态的电子结构，成功区分了体态和表面态，并通过轨道成分分析验证了实验与理论的一致性。
AI.motivation: 近期有报道指出PtBi₂表面可能存在拓扑超导，因此深入理解其表面电子结构至关重要。
AI.method: 采用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）结合光子能量依赖和偏振依赖测量，以及第一性原理计算，分析PtBi₂(0001)两个表面终止态的体态与表面态。
AI.result: 成功区分了两种表面终止态的体态和表面态，实验与计算结果吻合良好，并揭示了表面和体态中的轨道成分。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了PtBi₂两种表面终止态表面电子结构的统一图像，为理解其拓扑超导性质奠定了基础。

title: Using large language models to probe the limits of atom-centered structural descriptors
summary: Mapping an atomic structure to a compact set of geometric descriptors is an essential step in any machine-learning application to atomic-scale modeling. A powerful and widely-used approach can be understood as a discretization of the histogram of pair distances, triangles, etc., that results in a hierarchy of symmetry-invariant atom-centered descriptors. Unfortunately, the lower rungs on this hierarchy (two, three, four-neighbor clusters) were found to be incomplete, with symmetry-unrelated pairs of structures having exactly the same descriptors. However, all the ``descriptor degeneracies'' reported so far are resolved by considering larger clusters of neighbors to build the descriptors. We report examples of 3D structures that are indistinguishable even if one considers clusters of up to seven neighbors, and to arbitrary order when considering a practical level of discretization of the descriptors, discovered with the assistance of large language models. The key ingredients in their construction can be traced to results that have been known for decades in different communities; the model was able to find the references and recognize their significance for the problem at hand. We believe this experiment exposes an extremely fruitful usage pattern for AI in science: translating results between different communities and application domains, accelerating the process by which serendipitous discoveries in a field become paradigm-shifting breakthroughs in another.

AI.tldr: 本文发现即使考虑多达七个邻居的原子团簇，基于几何描述符的机器学习方法仍存在结构"简并性"（不同结构对应相同描述符），并通过大语言模型辅助发现了这些简并结构，揭示了AI在跨领域知识迁移中的巨大潜力。
AI.motivation: 原子尺度建模中，将原子结构映射为几何描述符是关键步骤。然而已有研究发现低阶描述符（二、三、四原子团簇）存在不完整性，即不同结构共享相同描述符。尽管之前认为通过考虑更大邻居团簇可以解决这一问题，但本文想验证这种"描述符简并性"是否真的能被完全消除。
AI.method: 利用大语言模型辅助搜索和识别三维结构中存在的描述符简并性，即使考虑多达七个邻居的团簇以及实际层面的任意阶离散化，仍发现了不可区分的结构。关键构造元素可追溯到不同领域已有数十年的已知理论，模型成功找到了这些参考文献并识别了它们对当前问题的意义。
AI.result: 发现了即使在考虑多达七个邻居团簇及任意高阶离散化情况下，3D结构中仍存在描述符简并性的具体反例。大语言模型成功跨领域检索并关联了相关经典理论结果，为这些简并结构的构造提供了理论依据。
AI.conclusion: 这一实验展示了AI在科学中极其有效的使用模式：将结果在不同社区和应用领域之间进行翻译，加速一个领域中的偶然发现成为另一个领域范式性突破的过程。

title: Physics-informed Machine Learning Prediction of Hubbard Interaction Parameters
summary: Accurate determination of Hubbard interaction parameters is essential for beyond-DFT approaches such as DFT+$U$, DFT+DMFT, and DFT+$U$+$V$ in correlated materials. In practice, however, these parameters are often chosen empirically, limiting their transferability across materials. Advanced computational approaches such as the constrained random-phase approximation (cRPA) provide a rigorous route for evaluating Hubbard interactions, but their computational cost remains a bottleneck for large-scale materials screening. Here, we present machine-learning (ML) models for predicting cRPA-derived Hubbard interaction parameters: effective on-site $U_{\rm eff}$, inter-site $V$, and Hund's coupling $J$ for transition-metal oxides (TMOs). We combine ensemble-learning models with a regression-based brute-force search (BFS) approach to achieve both predictive accuracy and explicit analytical expressions. We construct features that capture electronic, structural, and atomic properties, including the TM-$d$ bandwidth and TM-$d$/O-$p$ band-center separation, as physically motivated descriptors of localization and screening. Our ensemble models achieve RMSEs of 0.148 eV, 0.062 eV, and 0.007 eV for $U_{\rm eff}$, $V$, and $J$, respectively. The derived analytical forms directly relate $U_{\rm eff}$ to electron localization and TM-$d$/O-$p$ hybridization, suggest the importance of hybridization and structural compactness in determining $V$, and indicate that $J$ is governed primarily by elemental descriptors of the TM ion. Together, the present study provides an efficient approach for predicting cRPA-derived $U_{\rm eff}$, $V$, and $J$, while offering physical insight into the factors underlying these Hubbard interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出机器学习模型，用于预测过渡金属氧化物的cRPA导出的Hubbard相互作用参数（U_eff、V、J），结合集成学习与回归暴力搜索方法，实现了高精度预测（RMSE分别为0.148 eV、0.062 eV、0.007 eV），并给出了显式解析表达式，揭示了各参数的物理决定因素。
AI.motivation: 准确确定Hubbard相互作用参数对超越DFT的方法（如DFT+U、DFT+DMFT等）至关重要，但传统方法要么经验性强、可迁移性差，要么计算成本高（如cRPA），难以用于大规模材料筛选。
AI.method: 结合集成学习模型与基于回归的暴力搜索（BFS）方法，构造包含电子结构、晶体结构和原子性质的特征（如TM-d带宽、TM-d/O-p带中心分离），预测cRPA导出的U_eff、V和J参数，并得到显式解析表达式。
AI.result: 集成模型对U_eff、V和J的RMSE分别达到0.148 eV、0.062 eV和0.007 eV；解析表达式揭示了U_eff与电子局域化及TM-d/O-p杂化的关系，V受杂化和结构紧凑性影响，J主要由TM离子的元素描述符决定。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了一种高效预测cRPA导出Hubbard参数的方法，同时给出了这些参数背后的物理洞察，有望加速相关材料的大规模筛选。

title: Momentum Structure of Superconductivity and Sublattice Effects from Quasiparticle Interference in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$
summary: Quantum interference encoded in the sublattice texture of kagome Bloch wavefunctions has been widely invoked as a route to correlated states, including chiral charge order, unconventional superconductivity, and their possible intertwining in pair-density-wave (PDW) states. Using sub-Kelvin scanning tunneling microscopy, we conducted spectroscopic mapping of the kagome material CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ with high energy resolution and dense energy sampling through the superconducting gap. Quasiparticle interference (QPI) analysis, aided by ab initio and symmetry calculations, reveals an isotropic superconducting gap on the Fermi surfaces derived from V $M_z$-even ($M_z^+$) $d$ orbitals, thereby constraining possible gap symmetries and limiting any gap anisotropy to the remaining V $M_z$-odd ($M_z^-$) and Sb $p_z$ bands. Meanwhile, the CDW-peak-selected d$I$/d$V$ spectra closely track the spatially averaged density of states and show no distinct enhancement restricted to subgap energies, which do not support an additional PDW modulation within our sensitivity. Finally, the selective absence of specific QPI scattering vectors points to a spectroscopic sensitivity to sublattice character on the Fermi surface. Together, these results provide a clearer experimental picture of the low-energy electronic structure relevant to kagome superconductivity in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过亚开尔文扫描隧道显微镜对笼目材料CsV₃Sb₅进行高分辨率能谱映射，发现超导能隙在V的M_z⁺d轨道费米面上是各向同性的，CDW峰值选择的谱线未显示额外的PDW调制证据，并观察到特定QPI散射矢量的选择性缺失与亚晶格纹理的谱学敏感性有关。
AI.motivation: 量子干涉编码在笼目布洛赫波函数的亚晶格纹理中，被广泛认为是通向关联态（包括手性电荷序、非常规超导及可能的配对密度波态）的途径。本文旨在通过高分辨率实验揭示CsV₃Sb₅中与笼目超导相关的低能电子结构的清晰图像。
AI.method: 使用亚开尔文扫描隧道显微镜（STM）对CsV₃Sb₅进行高能量分辨率和密集能量采样的能谱映射，结合第一性原理计算和对称性分析进行准粒子干涉（QPI）分析。
AI.result: （1）源于V的M_z⁺d轨道的费米面上超导能隙是各向同性的，限制了可能的能隙对称性，各向异性仅限于M_z⁻和Sb p_z能带；（2）CDW峰值选择的dI/dV谱与空间平均态密度高度一致，未在亚隙能量处观察到额外增强，不支持存在额外的PDW调制；（3）特定QPI散射矢量的选择性缺失表明对费米面上亚晶格特征的谱学敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为笼目材料CsV₃Sb₅中与超导相关的低能电子结构提供了更清晰的实验图景，揭示了各向同性超导能隙、排除了额外PDW调制，并展示了亚晶格纹理对谱学测量的重要影响。

title: Asymmetric Floquet-Engineered Mode Coupling in Hybrid Magnonics
summary: In hybrid magnonic systems, linear magnon--photon hybridization inherently produces symmetric, reciprocal interactions, precluding asymmetric mode coupling. Floquet driving can tailor mode coupling strengths but, with single-tone modulation, inevitably generates a symmetric interaction that preserves this reciprocity. Here we introduce dual-tone Floquet modulation to unlock a new degree of freedom in hybrid magnonic systems, where the relative phase $θ$ of two commensurate drives continuously controls the asymmetry of the Floquet-engineered interaction, enabling asymmetric mode coupling absent in existing hybrid magnonic systems. We demonstrate this in a strongly coupled cavity magnonic device, where tuning $θ$ reversibly switches single-sided Autler--Townes splitting between the two hybrid modes---a direct spectroscopic signature of phase-programmable asymmetric coupling. This approach opens a new path toward controllable nonreciprocal and topological functionalities in hybrid magnonic systems, with broad implications for advanced quantum and classical signal processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双音Floquet调制技术，通过调节两驱动信号的相对相位θ，在混合磁振子系统中实现了可编程的非对称模式耦合，并在实验上观察到单向Autler-Townes分裂这一非对称耦合的直接光谱证据。
AI.motivation: 现有混合磁振子系统中的线性杂化只能产生对称互易耦合，而单音Floquet调制也无法打破这一对称性。因此，亟需一种能实现非对称模式耦合的新方法，以解锁非互易和拓扑功能。
AI.method: 引入双音Floquet调制（两个共调制的驱动信号），利用其相对相位θ作为新自由度，在强耦合腔磁振子器件中工程化非对称耦合强度。
AI.result: 通过调节θ，可逆地切换两个杂化模式之间的单侧Autler-Townes分裂，直接证明了相位可编程的非对称耦合的存在。
AI.conclusion: 该技术为混合磁振子系统实现可控非互易和拓扑功能开辟了新路径，对先进量子及经典信号处理具有重要意义。

title: Temporal Interference from Topological Transitions in Monitored Quantum Dynamics
summary: Temporal interference patterns can be detected with stroboscopic monitoring that treats the back action of measurements and the unitary dynamics. Previous work established that the mean detected recurrence time is integer-quantized and given by a topological invariant, a winding number $w$. When measurement periods are at resonance with the system's timescales, the winding number can abruptly change. We focus on a generic quantum system and the transition $w\to w-2$, signified by the creation of two dark states in Hilbert space, whose corresponding modes are responsible for the interference pattern. Close to the transition an extremely slow decay of the amplitude of first detection is found, superimposed by oscillations, in contrast to the monotonically exponential decay close to the case $w\to w-1$. We show how these oscillations are obtained from the symmetry of the system and find the conditions for optimal observations of the phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了量子系统中时间干涉模式的随机监测现象，发现平均检测递归时间由拓扑不变量（缠绕数w）整数量化，并揭示了从w→w-2的拓扑相变中暗态的产生导致检测振幅出现极慢衰减和振荡行为。
AI.motivation: 探究在随机监测（频闪探测）下，量子系统的测量反作用与幺正动力学如何共同产生时间干涉模式，特别是拓扑相变（缠绕数变化）附近新奇的动力学行为。
AI.method: 采用随机监测的频闪测量框架，分析量子系统在一系列周期性测量下的首次检测概率；通过拓扑缠绕数刻画平均递归时间的量子化；利用对称性分析解析了w→w-2相变附近震荡模式的来源。
AI.result: 发现w→w-2相变时希尔伯特空间中产生两个暗态，其对应模式主导干涉图案；相变附近检测振幅呈现极慢衰减并叠加振荡，与w→w-1时的单调指数衰减不同；给出了最优观测这些现象的条件。
AI.conclusion: 时间干涉模式的拓扑本质通过量子化缠绕数被揭示，w→w-2相变时暗态的产生导致独特的非指数衰减动力学，为量子测量中的拓扑效应提供了新见解。

title: Electronic and magnetic properties of small one-dimensional Wigner crystals from an ab initio approach
summary: We present an \emph{ab initio} method to study the electronic and magnetic properties of small one-dimensional Wigner crystals. In particular, we focus on the calculation of the electronic charge distribution and the exchange coupling constant. Our theoretical studies are motivated by the experimental observation of few-electron Wigner crystals in a carbon nanotube [Science 364, 870 (2019)]. We model the experimental setup by confining electrons in a one-dimensional potential well with infinite side barriers. We represent the Hamiltonian of the system in a basis of Slater determinants and perform full configuration interaction to ensure we capture all the electron correlation for a given basis set. As the one-particle basis set we use particle-in-a-box wave functions which by construction satisfy the boundary conditions. With our approach, we obtain accurate electronic density profiles of small one-dimensional Wigner crystals. These profiles clearly show the localisation of the electrons. Finally, we present a simple approach to obtain the exchange coupling constant by mapping our \textit{ab initio} method on a Heisenberg Hamiltonian. We illustrate our approach on a Wigner dimer. We obtain excellent agreement with a result in the literature.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从头算方法研究一维维格纳晶体的电子和磁性性质，通过全组态相互作用和粒子在一维盒子中的波函数基组，准确计算了电子密度分布和交换耦合常数，并在维格纳二聚体上获得了与文献一致的结果。
AI.motivation: 受2019年碳纳米管中少电子维格纳晶体的实验观察启发，需要发展一种能够准确描述一维维格纳晶体电子关联效应和交换相互作用的理论方法。
AI.method: 将电子限制在具有无限侧势垒的一维势阱中，采用粒子在一维盒子中的波函数作为单粒子基组，构建斯莱特行列式基，通过全组态相互作用（FCI）方法求解哈密顿量，捕捉电子关联效应；通过映射到海森堡哈密顿量提取交换耦合常数。
AI.result: 成功获得了小一维维格纳晶体的精确电子密度分布，清晰显示了电子的局域化特征；在维格纳二聚体上计算交换耦合常数，与文献结果吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 该从头算方法能够准确描述一维维格纳晶体的电子和磁性性质，为理解这类强关联电子体系提供了可靠的理论工具。

title: No band gap, no problem: Defects in InAs using a band-avoiding occupation-constrained density functional theory
summary: Density functional theory (DFT) underestimates the experimental band gap---the infamous band gap problem. As the band gap defines the energy scale of defect levels, this complicates computation of charge transition energies for atomic defects. In the extreme case of narrow-gap semiconductors, the DFT band gap collapses to zero, seemingly precluding quantitative predictions of defect levels. We present a band-avoiding occupation-constrained DFT (ba-occ-DFT) approach that prevents spurious occupation of band-edge states and enables reliable total energy calculations of atomic defects. Application to indium arsenide (InAs) shows that ba-occ-DFT circumvents the band gap problem, separates band-edge errors from defect level calculations, and enables rigorous defect level predictions in a narrow-gap semiconductor despite a zero DFT band gap.

AI.tldr: 针对DFT带隙低估问题（尤其在窄带隙半导体中带隙为零的情况），提出了一种带规避占据约束DFT方法(ba-occ-DFT)，通过防止带边态的错误占据，实现了原子缺陷的可靠总能量计算，并在InAs中验证了该方法能规避带隙问题、分离带边误差，实现窄带隙半导体的缺陷能级预测。
AI.motivation: DFT存在著名的带隙问题（低估实验带隙），这在计算原子缺陷的电荷跃迁能时带来困难。极端情况下窄带隙半导体的DFT带隙坍缩为零，似乎完全无法进行缺陷能级的定量预测。
AI.method: 提出带规避占据约束DFT方法(ba-occ-DFT)，通过防止带边态的错误占据，使得在DFT带隙为零的情况下也能进行可靠的缺陷总能量计算。
AI.result: 在InAs上的应用表明，ba-occ-DFT能够规避带隙问题，将带边误差与缺陷能级计算分离开来，在DFT带隙为零的窄带隙半导体中实现了严格的缺陷能级预测。
AI.conclusion: ba-occ-DFT有效解决了DFT带隙问题对缺陷计算的影响，为窄带隙半导体中的缺陷能级预测提供了可行方案。

title: PUDA: An AI-Native Hardware Harness for Self-Driving Laboratories
summary: Physical Unified Device Architecture (PUDA) is an AI-native hardware harness for self-driving laboratories (SDLs). Rather than building a human-centered graphical user interface (GUI) orchestration layer, PUDA creates a command-line runtime environment that lets agents observe, orient, decide, and act over experiments while hardware execution remains deterministic, atomic, and auditable. Headless by design, devices appear through discoverable command-line interfaces, JSON protocols are routed through a distributed messaging system, and command responses, data products, and reports are preserved as structured records. PUDA organizes protocols, runs, samples, measurements, and command logs into an AI-native data structure linked by run identifiers and timestamps, preserving provenance from submitted protocol through hardware response to resulting data products. PUDA separates scientific orchestration from physical operation and data telemetry: agents choose experiments, while PUDA executes validated commands and captures provenance-linked state, responses, and data. The contribution is not another optimizer, orchestrator, or recipe language. It is a practical execution and data environment for agentic SDLs; the broader physical AI implication is that PUDA provides an AI-native hardware harness for AI systems to interact with physical tools.

AI.tldr: PUDA是一个AI原生的命令行硬件平台，用于自主实验室，让AI代理通过结构化、可审计的命令行环境观察、决策并执行实验，同时保持硬件执行的确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有SDL系统依赖面向人类的GUI编排层，缺乏AI原生交互方式，难以让AI代理直接、原子化地与硬件设备交互并保留完整实验溯源。
AI.method: 采用无头设计，设备通过可发现的CLI呈现；JSON协议通过分布式消息系统路由；使用AI原生数据结构（含协议、运行、样本、测量和命令日志）通过运行ID和时间戳链接，保留从提交协议到硬件响应的完整溯源。
AI.result: 将科学编排与物理操作/遥测分离，AI代理选择实验，PUDA执行已验证命令并捕获溯源链接的状态、响应和数据。
AI.conclusion: PUDA不是又一个优化器或编排语言，而是面向代理型SDL的实用执行与数据环境，为AI系统与物理工具交互提供了AI原生硬件接口。

title: Same-spin Andreev reflections in the quantum Hall regime: the role of loss
summary: The interfaces of superconductors and topological materials hold promise for realizing exotic states and excitations. An important example is provided by the chiral Andreev edge states (CAES), which are formed at interfaces between quantum Hall (QH) states and superconductors (SC). CAES combine electron and hole amplitudes which are hybridized via Andreev reflections. This study explores the spin properties of the CAES through selective spin filtering of the QH edge channels. We find robust evidence of spin-flips accompanying the Andreev processes: electrons can be reflected from the superconductor as holes in the same spin channel. We demonstrate that the distribution of the reflection probabilities is exponential and then use random matrix theory to account for this observation. Finally, we observe Andreev reflections in the spin-polarized ν = 1 case, which is enabled by particle loss. Our findings shed light on the mechanism underlying Andreev reflections of spin-polarized chiral states. They also demonstrate the importance of considering non-Hermiticity when constructing topological superconductors in hybrid materials.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了量子霍尔态与超导体界面处的手性安德烈夫边缘态（CAES）的自旋特性，发现安德烈夫过程中存在自旋翻转，反射概率呈指数分布，并利用随机矩阵理论解释该现象。研究还观察到自旋极化ν=1情况下的安德烈夫反射，揭示了非厄米性在构建拓扑超导体中的重要性。
AI.motivation: 探索超导体与拓扑材料界面处的手性安德烈夫边缘态（CAES）的自旋特性，理解其自旋翻转机制，以及非厄米性在拓扑超导体构建中的作用。
AI.method: 通过对量子霍尔边缘通道进行选择性自旋滤波，测量安德烈夫反射过程；利用随机矩阵理论分析反射概率的指数分布。
AI.result: 发现安德烈夫过程中存在自旋翻转（电子被反射为同一自旋通道的空穴）；反射概率呈指数分布；在自旋极化的ν=1情况下观测到粒子损失驱动的安德烈夫反射。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了自旋极化手性态中安德烈夫反射的机制，强调了非厄米性在混合材料构建拓扑超导体中的关键作用。

title: Neural variational framework for random Young-diagram limit shapes
summary: We develop a structure-preserving neural variational framework for random Young-diagram ensembles, with representations adapted to the structure and scaling of each measure. The method is validated on the Plancherel, uniform, minimal-difference, and fixed-\(q\) \(q\)-Plancherel ensembles, using known asymptotic profiles only for post-training comparison. We then study a quartically deformed hook-length ensemble without assuming an analytical saddle shape. Large-\(n\) neural profiles are compared with finite-size MAP profiles obtained from exact-action searches and with mean profiles obtained from corner-transfer Metropolis--Hastings sampling. Increasing the deformation suppresses the leading rows and broadens the support, while the neural, discrete, and sampled mean profiles agree at the percent level. These results provide numerical evidence for a deformation-dependent macroscopic saddle family.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种保留结构的神经变分框架，用于随机杨图系综，并在多种系综上验证了其有效性。通过研究四次变形钩长系综，发现神经、离散和采样平均轮廓在百分比级别上一致，为变形依赖的宏观鞍点族提供了数值证据。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理随机杨图系综时，往往需要假设解析鞍点形状来获得宏观轮廓。本文旨在发展一种无需先验解析形状假设的通用框架，能够自动捕捉系综的结构和尺度特征。
AI.method: 提出结构保留的神经变分框架，利用神经网络表示适应每个测度结构和尺度的杨图系综。对Plancherel、均匀、最小差和固定q的q-Plancherel系综进行验证（仅用已知渐近轮廓作训练后对比）。对四次变形钩长系综，通过精确作用搜索获得有限尺寸最大后验轮廓，通过角转移Metropolis-Hastings采样获得平均轮廓，并与神经网络结果比较。
AI.result: 在四次变形钩长系综中，增大变形会抑制主导行并扩展支撑区域。神经、离散和采样平均轮廓在百分比级别上达成一致。这为存在变形依赖的宏观鞍点族提供了数值证据。
AI.conclusion: 本文发展的结构保留神经变分框架能有效处理多种随机杨图系综，无需先验解析鞍点形状假设。四次变形实验表明存在一个连续依赖变形的宏观鞍点族，这为理解杨图系综的相变行为提供了新视角。

title: Microscopic Emergence of Ancilla Lattice Physics in the Emery Model
summary: We derive a controlled low-energy effective theory for the three-band Emery model on the Lieb lattice near (n=2) filling. Starting from the positive charge-transfer regime, a sequence of Schrieffer--Wolff transformations rigorously establishes a direct microscopic mapping onto an ancillary lattice structure. For realistic cuprate-like parameters, this framework naturally reproduces the conventional Fermi-liquid (FL) phase at a filling shifted by one electron per site. Our analysis identifies the precise microscopic conditions required to access the exotic fractionalized Fermi-liquid (FL$^*$) phase. We show that realizing FL$^*$ requires nonstandard cuprate parameter regimes together with additional interactions that stabilize a quantum spin liquid in the background ancilla layer. These results establish a microscopic foundation for ancilla physics in multiorbital materials and clarify the conditions for realizing FL$^*$. We discuss the possibility to replicate ancilla model physics in Lieb lattice cold atom simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文从Lieb晶格上的三带Emery模型出发，通过Schrieffer-Wolff变换推导出低能有效理论，建立了到辅助晶格结构的微观映射，并分析了实现非常规分数量子费米液体（FL*）相的微观条件。
AI.motivation: 作者希望建立ancilla模型在真实多轨道材料中的微观基础，理解分数量子费米液体FL*相的实现条件，并探索在冷原子体系中模拟ancilla模型物理的可能性。
AI.method: 从正电荷转移区域出发，利用一系列Schrieffer-Wolff变换，将Lieb晶格上的三带Emery模型严格映射到辅助晶格结构上，并分析不同参数区域下的相行为。
AI.result: 在铜酸盐类似参数下自然得到费米液体相（填充偏移一个电子/位点）；揭示了实现FL*相需要非标准铜酸盐参数及额外的相互作用来稳定背景辅助层中的量子自旋液体。
AI.conclusion: 为ancilla物理在多轨道材料中建立了微观基础，阐明了实现FL*的条件，并讨论了在Lieb晶格冷原子模拟中复制ancilla模型物理的可能性。

title: Nanoscale Imaging of Strain-Controlled Altermagnetic Domains in α-MnTe
summary: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, offering a route to spintronic functionality without the stray fields of conventional ferromagnets. Mechanical strain provides a promising means of controlling their Néel order, yet the microscopic pathway by which strain reorganizes an altermagnetic texture remains unresolved. Here, we integrate a piezo-driven uniaxial strain cell with scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry to image the magnetic domains of bulk α-MnTe during in situ compression at room temperature. We find that compression reorganizes the magnetic texture through domain coalescence, increasing the size of the largest connected domain while reducing the domain-wall density. Upon unloading, however, the strain-formed domain network does not retrace the loading pathway. Instead, the large connected regions fragment into a new metastable configuration, producing pronounced hysteresis in the maximum domain size and stray-field distribution. These results identify domain connectivity and topology as key carriers of strain-induced magnetic memory. Our work reveals domain coalescence and hysteretic fragmentation as the microscopic pathway of strain control in α-MnTe and establishes a route toward strain-programmable altermagnetic textures and reconfigurable spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过扫描氮空位磁力显微镜结合压电驱动应变装置，原位观测了反铁磁材料α-MnTe在单轴压缩下的磁畴演化，发现应变通过畴合并重新组织磁织构，卸载后发生滞后的畴碎片化，揭示了畴连接性与拓扑性作为应变诱导磁记忆的关键载体。
AI.motivation: 机械应变被认为是控制交变磁材料Néel序的有效手段，但微观上应变如何重新组织交变磁织构的路径尚不明确。
AI.method: 将压电驱动的单轴应变装置与扫描氮空位磁力测量技术结合，在室温下原位成像块体α-MnTe在压缩过程中的磁畴结构变化。
AI.result: 压缩通过畴合并重组磁织构，增大最大连通畴尺寸并降低畴壁密度；卸载时畴网络不沿加载路径回溯，而是碎片化为新的亚稳态构型，在最大畴尺寸和杂散场分布上产生显著滞后。
AI.conclusion: 畴连接性和拓扑性是应变诱导磁记忆的关键载体，揭示了畴合并与滞后碎片化作为α-MnTe应变控制的微观路径，为应变可编程交变磁织构和可重构自旋电子器件奠定了基础。

title: Scanning Gate Microscopy Modulation of Supercurrent in Graphene Josephson Junctions
summary: Graphene Josephson junctions represent an excellent platform for quantum technologies, thanks to the combination of high carrier mobility, ballistic transport, and large gate-tunable critical currents, preserved even under quantizing magnetic fields. Investigating the spatial distribution of supercurrent flow could be crucial for elucidating transport mechanisms and advancing the engineering of these devices.
